title: •Tamtel Skreej
caption: •Tamtel Skreej (V)
game_text: Deploys only to a Tatooine site as an Undercover spy. Once during each control phase, if Undercover, may relocate your character at a related site to Lando’s site (for free). Once per game, may ▼ Vibro-Ax on Lando for free.
lore: *Gambler*. Lando Calrissian posed as a guard for Jabba in order to spy on the Hutt. Feared that he would be recognized by some of Jabba’s companions.
copyright: TM & © 1998 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1998 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Stats POWER 3 / ABILITY 3 / FORCE-ATTUNED (label only); deploy 3 / forfeit 6. Icon column: pilot, warrior. Curly apostrophe in Lando’s; ▼ where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. Alien (Lando in disguise; alien disc on the scan). Lore corrected from scan: curly apostrophe in Jabba’s. 'Gambler' is a characteristic but reads as plain weight on the 346 px scan (same stroke as the rest of the line) — left unbolded; low-res only, so this is a judgment call (Jabba's Palace predates Decipher's bolded-keyword lore). Base scan only at 346×488; copyright 1998 (Jabba's Palace). Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3 -pre, 350 px). Bold *Gambler* inferred from the Jabba's Palace printing pattern (Wooof, Jabba, Fozec show bold characteristics on 745 px scans); only 350 px scans of this card exist.
